newline_convention: For text, hash the exact bytes of the declared inclusive Git-blob lines, preserving existing line terminators and adding no synthetic final LF. Binary ranges are whole-file bytes.

supersession.reason: V2 is retained failure evidence because 41 declared text range hashes did not match the frozen Git objects. V3 independently recomputes every envelope and is the package-level source-evidence replacement only after its standalone verification has zero mismatches.
supersession.scope_limit: This does not select V3 in immutable truth-test v5, approve a mapper, constitute independent review, or authorize a candidate or accepted manifest.

claim_contract.semantic_rule: Each fact is limited to literals, expressions, calls, branches, or test-source structure present in its exact range. required_substrings are conjunctive and are verifier inputs, not substitutes for review.
